scope: The late-2024 Auwal Masjid exterior at 39 Dorp Street in Bo-Kaap, including its gray-green stepped frontage, white framed entrance grille, small street windows and stepped minaret with dark cap.

originalReview.notes: The street photo shows the olive-gray plaster and cream horizontal bands, white framed arched gate, tall narrow central windows, railed minaret stage and dark faceted cap.

quallaSearch.notes: Used the exact first-party Qualla CC0 exterior. The cropped street image controls the photographed central frontage and minaret. The mapped envelope controls the full plan.
